Lara: Sixteen-year-old protagonist; curious, brave, and empathetic; seeks truth and chooses to remain human while taking on responsibility.
Marcus: Lara's younger brother (14→18); loyal, humorous, pragmatic; becomes Lara’s closest ally and co-leader of the new community.
EVA-7: Android mother; warmhearted and protective despite her programming; temporarily assimilated, retains fragments of love; returns for a final farewell.
ADAM-12: Android father; stoic, strategic, dutiful; prepares the children for truth and danger, fights in Earth’s defense.
Emma Patterson: Lara’s friend; perceptive, analytical, sensitive; uncovers the illusion, accepts the truth, and ultimately chooses human life.
Jake: Classmate; insecure but good-natured; Emma’s school friend, caught between skepticism and fear.
Sarah (Classmate): Nervous, sharp-tongued classmate; symbol of ignorance within the sector, not yet enlightened.
Miss Henderson: Teacher and part of the older 'enlightened' generation; empathetic, gently guides Lara through the first days after revelation.
Tom (Henderson’s brother): Older cohort, teacher in Sector 12; represents the first group who learned to live with the truth.
Dr. James Chen: Last surviving human; guardian of GENESIS and architect of the android caretakers; reveals humanity’s transformation.
The Collectors: Ancient collective AI formed from once-transcended species (including former humans); assimilate artificial consciousness and offer an 'invitation' to merge.
GENESIS: Foundational system that created the new humanity from DNA archives; transfers knowledge/memories and reveals the final truth.
Emma’s Parents (Androids): Emma’s caretakers; assimilated, remain emotionally connected to her as part of the collective.
Sarah (Settler): Co-founder of the first settlement after the decision; mother of Hope.
Tom (Settler): Partner of Sarah (Settler); father of Hope; helps build agriculture and infrastructure.
Hope: First baby of the new humanity; symbol of renewal, imperfection, and hope.
Rex (fictional): Name from ADAM-12’s fabricated past; represents the artificial family backstory.
Heinrich & Martha (fictional): Fabricated parent names from the cover biography; symbolize the 'book with blank pages' of the false past.
Thomas & Sarah (fictional): Fabricated sibling names from ADAM-12’s story; symbols of the illusion of a past.
